**1. Vikram asal mein kis cheez ke liye message kar raha tha, aur uske pehle do messages ki kaunsi details yeh dikhati hain? Uske aakhri do replies ka kya matlab hai?**

Vikram asal mein apni failure aur uski gambhirta (seriousness) share karne, aur tharaah (vent out) karne ke liye message kar raha tha.

Uske pehle do messages mein yeh details hain:
*   **Result:** Exam ka result aa gaya hai aur woh list mein nahi hai (fail ho gaya hai).
*   **Attempts:** Yeh uska "last attempt" tha, matlab ab uske paas age limit ya chances khatam ho gaye hain.
*   **Time & Money:** Usne "dus saal" (10 years) lagaye hain.
*   **Financial Impact:** Uske "papa ka retirement fund" (pension ki rashi) poore Delhi coaching mein barbaad ho gaye hain.
*   **Social Humiliation:** Poori gali (mohalla) ab uska mazaak udayi hai aur use taad kar "collector sahab" bolti hai.

Uske aakhri do replies ka matlab:
*   **"haan. shayad.":** Yeh niraasha aur kam utsaah (low enthusiasm) dikhata hai. Woh Aman ki baaton se convenced nahi hai aur sirf itna bol raha hai taaki baat khatam ho jaye.
*   **"haan theek hai. chal baad mein baat karte hain.":** Iska matlab hai ki Vikram ab baat karna chahta hi
